author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
Installing a ceiling fan can be one of those jobs that gets frustrating fast — especially when you’re balancing heavy parts on a ladder, dealing with tiny screws, and trying to make electrical connections overhead. This new quick-install ceiling fan design solves a lot of those problems.

In this video, I’m showing you a ceiling fan installation system that makes mounting, wiring, blade installation, and light kit assembly faster and easier.

The mounting bracket uses T-hole slots so you can loosen the existing junction box screws, slide the bracket into place, and tighten it down without fighting to hold everything at once. The larger housing also helps cover drywall damage, old paint lines, or imperfections around a standard 4-inch electrical box.

title: This New Ceiling Fan Makes Installation SO Much Easier
